name: origin
description: Git worktrees, pull request merges, and keeping a branch on top of the head branch, from one tested CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Create, list and remove git worktrees; merge pull requests; rebase onto the head branch.
interface.longDescription: Wraps the git, GitHub and GitLab operations that are easy to get wrong. Creates a worktree for a branch and refuses destinations that belong to another repository. Removes a worktree only when its branch is finished, deleting the branch when it is provably merged and printing the command that restores it. Merges a pull request with a written body instead of a commit list. Rebases the current branch onto a freshly fetched head branch. GitHub through gh, GitLab through glab; the worktree commands need neither.
